items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: Joe Gabriel would lead the band like a band major. He was a violin player.

ctx.x: Yeah, I mean, I wondered about the brass band.

Well, he was a violin player and when they had a Kishens or brass band, well, they would form into a brass band. Joe Gabriel would lead the band like a band major. He was a violin player. He didn't play no other instrument, but he would direct them and they would play brass bands.

Can you remember what any of the dance bands were like up there when you were, oh, as far back as you can remember? That is, did it sound like the New Orleans jazz bands here? Was it a different type of music? What would you say? How did it compare?

items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Only with Joe Gabriel band, but he didn't play with bands in the Orleans, with parades.

ctx.x: But did he play any dance jobs, I mean, other than the brass band?
Only with Joe Gabriel band, but he didn't play with bands in the Orleans, with parades.
Do you remember any drummers, early drummers way back when you were a kid, you know, that would be out in the street that impressed you? That's being good?
